decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the internal surfaces of the works hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority a method statement proving that the minimum alteration to the historic fabric of the building required to install the proposed dry lining will be undertaken.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until referenced examples (including manufacturer's statement) regarding the potential impacts of the proposed under floor heating have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until fixing and construction details regarding impacts upon existing ceiling, panelling and skirting have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Specifically this would involve details on methods of fixing plywood flooring to existing floorboards and joists; installing soil and service pipes; and installing dry lining over
;a)	Existing timber panelling
b)	Existing lath and plaster.
Condition : 8 - Ventilation gaps between approved shower cubicle and external walls to be a minimum of 100mm.
description: New bathroom and shower room on 2nd floor and formation of one new door and new partition
